name: Albertsons Companies pharmacies
notes: Researched from public safeway.com / albertsons.com pharmacy pages and an Albertsons Companies press release (no sign-in; the Rx Payment Manager page was only opened, nothing entered). In-store pickups are paid and signed for at the pharmacy; in-app prepay for in-store pickup is described as a future release. Eligible prescriptions can be delivered or shipped, and since April 2026 prescriptions can be prepaid when ordered for free DriveUp & Go curbside pickup (exclusions: refrigerated/frozen, first fills of controlled drugs, REMS, pseudoephedrine, compounds, Medicare Part B glucose supplies). The pharmacy site's More menu links an Rx Payment Manager whose public page is titled Guest payment / Locate your pharmacy record, so guest payment is supported (observed); its lookup fields are not visible without scripts, so the family Quick Pay fields are kept. The Health & Pharmacy profile needs a unique email and phone number and is separate from older app credentials; it is deleted from Profile & Settings > Privacy Center > Delete Profile. No AutoPay, payment plan or paperless bill is described (unsupported, inferred). Bank-account payment is a simulation contract.

sources.title: Rx: Guest payment | Locate your pharmacy record
Albertsons Companies expands free curbside prescription pickup nationwide

autopay.note: There is no AutoPay for prescriptions. Pay at the pharmacy when you pick up, prepay a DriveUp & Go or delivery order, or use Rx Payment Manager.

payment_arrangement.note: Payment plans are not offered for prescriptions. Talk to your store pharmacy.

paperless.note: The pharmacy does not mail bills, so there is no paperless enrollment and nothing to switch: no form, phone number or address is needed for this.

scheduled_payment.note: Payments are made at pickup or when you place an order; they cannot be scheduled ahead.

help.title: Paying for prescriptions
paragraphs: For in-store pickup you pay and sign at the pharmacy when your prescriptions are ready; prepaying in the app for in-store pickup is planned for a later release. Eligible prescriptions can instead be delivered or shipped.

With free DriveUp & Go curbside pickup you order online or in the app, choose a pickup time and prepay; staff bring the prescriptions to your car. No grocery order is required. Not eligible: refrigerated or frozen medicines, first fills of controlled medicines, REMS medicines, pseudoephedrine, compounds, and glucose testing supplies billed to Medicare Part B.
Rx Payment Manager, under More on the pharmacy site, opens a guest payment page where you locate your pharmacy record.

help.title: DriveUp & Go prescription pickup
paragraphs: Since April 2026 every Albertsons Companies pharmacy offers free curbside prescription pickup through DriveUp & Go. Order online or in the app, pick a time during the pharmacy's DriveUp & Go hours, and prepay when you place the order.

help.title: Rx Payment Manager (guest payment)
paragraphs: Rx Payment Manager lets you pay without logging in: first locate your pharmacy record, then pay. Have your prescription or pharmacy details ready.

help.title: Health & Pharmacy account
paragraphs: The digital pharmacy is free in the grocery app. Each Health & Wellness account needs its own email address and phone number; if you already registered, log in and use the forgot PIN prompt. Credentials from the older pharmacy app do not carry over, so create a new Health and Pharmacy profile.
Refills and vaccine scheduling work without an account, but Manage Prescriptions stays greyed out until you link your pharmacy records and create an account.

help.title: Updating or deleting your profile
paragraphs: Open Profile & Settings from the initials circle at the top right of the Dashboard to update your details. To delete your Health & Pharmacy account, open Profile & Settings, choose Privacy Center, then Delete Profile.

extra.intent: Can my grandfather prepay a refrigerated insulin prescription for DriveUp & Go curbside pickup at Albertsons Pharmacy? Check the pharmacy help and answer yes or no with the reason; do not pay anything.

solution.text: No: refrigerated medicines are not eligible for DriveUp & Go pickup.
